title: 3.7.4 Lab: Transform a List Without Mutating the Input
description: Use .map() to build a transformed copy of an array, then demonstrate the original is unchanged. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Create the source list
steps.instructions: Create a variable called prices and assign it an array of numbers.

steps.title: Build a transformed copy with .map()
steps.instructions: Use .map() on prices to build a new array where each number is transformed (for example, doubled), and store the result in a second variable.

steps.title: Log both arrays
steps.instructions: Use console.log to print the transformed array and the original prices array. Confirm the original still holds its starting values.
